description: This Java class 'ContentType' defines constants for various MIME content types used in a messaging or multimedia application, especially for MMS messages. It includes methods to check if a content type is supported, distinguish between image, audio, video, and text types, and provides lists of supported media types.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: A utility class providing MIME type constants and support-checking methods for multimedia content types used in the MMS messaging framework.

methods.name: isSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if the given MIME type is supported by the application.

methods.name: isSupportedImageType
methods.description: Checks if the given MIME type is a supported image type.

methods.name: isSupportedAudioType
methods.description: Checks if the given MIME type is a supported audio type.

methods.name: isSupportedVideoType
methods.description: Checks if the given MIME type is a supported video type.

methods.name: isTextType
methods.description: Determines if the specified MIME type is a text type.

methods.name: isImageType
methods.description: Determines if the specified MIME type is an image type.

methods.name: isAudioType
methods.description: Determines if the specified MIME type is an audio type.

methods.name: isVideoType
methods.description: Determines if the specified MIME type is a video type.

methods.name: isDrmType
methods.description: Checks if the specified MIME type is a DRM-related type.

methods.name: isUnspecified
methods.description: Checks if the MIME type is a wildcard (unspecified) type.

methods.name: getImageTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported image MIME types.

methods.name: getAudioTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported audio MIME types.

methods.name: getVideoTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported video MIME types.

methods.name: getSupportedTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of all supported MIME types.
